jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Orange County Fire Authority is recruiting to fill one (1\) GIS Analyst position, which will provide support to the IT/GIS Division. This recruitment will fill the current vacancy and establish an eligibility list for future vacancies.

 **CLASS SUMMARY:**


Incumbents are responsible for performing professional level activities under supervision in administering, maintaining, troubleshooting, and/or developing GIS computer systems and/or applications. Incumbents may serve as a lead on Projects and to lower\-level staff.. Incumbents may also serve as a subject matter expert in the area of assignment. Incumbents may be required to serve on an emergency response team in the field.

 **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:**


The GIS Analyst is the third level in a four\-level Geographic Information Systems series. The GIS Analyst is distinguished from the GIS Technician by its project lead responsibilities and level of experience in a specific area of expertise, and scope of responsibility under supervision.

**SCHEDULE OF EVENTS****:**


Recruitment Closes: Wednesday, September 9 @ 11:59 pm


Oral Interviews: Scheduled for the week of September 28, 2026


Selection Interviews: Scheduled for the week of October 5, 2026
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
-----------------------


***(These duties are intended to be representative samples of the duties performed by the class.)***


To view the essential functions, knowledge, and skills for this position, please use the link to the classification specification provided below.


GIS Analyst


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------


An equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job, such as those listed above.

 **EDUCATION** ***(position requirements at entry):***

* Bachelor's Degree in Geography, or a related field

 **EXPERIENCE** ***(position requirements at entry)*****:**

* Three (3\) years of GIS experience.

 **LICENSE AND CERTIFICATIONS** ***(position requirements at entry):***

* GISP Certificate is highly desired.

 **HIGHLY DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands\-on experience using SQL Server and T\-SQL for data validation, reporting, geospatial analysis, views, queries, or stored procedures.
* Hands\-on experience developing automation workflows using Python, ArcPy, ArcGIS API for Python, or similar scripting tools.
* Hands\-on experience developing or configuring web GIS applications using JavaScript, Arcade, ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, Experience Builder, Dashboards, or related Esri technologies.
* Experience administering, publishing, or supporting ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, and Esri enterprise geodatabases.
* Experience supporting mobile GIS workflows using ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, offline maps, forms, or field data collection tools.
* Experience with data modeling, relational databases, ETL processes, enterprise data integration, and GIS data quality control.
* Experience supporting public safety GIS workflows, including CAD, routing, network analysis, dispatch support, emergency response mapping, or operational data maintenance.
* Experience working with fire service, emergency management, public safety, or other mission\-critical operational environments.

**SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION**
----------------------------


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**


Positions in this class typically require stooping, reaching, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, talking, hearing, seeing, and repetitive motions.

 **Light Work:** Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for Sedentary Work and the work sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

 **WORKING CONDITIONS:**


Incumbents may be subjected to moving mechanical parts and electrical currents.

 ***NOTE: The above job description is intended to represent only the key areas of responsibilities; specific position assignments will vary depending on the needs of the department.***

 **PRE\-HIRE REQUIREMENTS:**


Before an employee is hired, he/she must successfully complete pre\-employment requirements including, but not limited to fingerprinting and background check, reference check, DMV check, licensure/certification check, Oath of allegiance to the United States of America and the State of California, and proof of eligibility to work in the United States in accordance with Immigration and Reform Control Act of 1986\. All job offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a pre\-employment medical exam, including a drug screen through the OCFA's designated physician.

 **HOW TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION:**


When the recruitment opens for this position, an applicant must submit, during the application filing period, an online application and attach any supplemental information as required in the job announcement which may include submitting responses to a supplemental questionnaire. Online resumes and other unsolicited materials may be attached but will not be considered in lieu of the required online application, unless otherwise specified in the job announcement. The OCFA reserves the right to limit the number of online applications when necessary. Applicants are responsible for maintaining/updating their contact information through the online application system.

 **INITIAL SELECTION REVIEW:**


The Human Resources Division reviews all initial application materials to identify qualified applicants. Applicants meeting minimum qualifications will be invited to the first phase of the recruitment process. The OCFA reserves the right to refer only the better qualified applicants if the number of applicants is high. jobs.title: Research Data Analyst 1
jobs.description:
WORK SCHEDULE:
Hybrid work arrangement with at least 4 days per week on\-site.  

  

BUDGETED SALARY:
The expected pay range for this position is $85,926 to $104,477 per annum.  

SCHOOL/UNIT DESCRIPTION:
Stanford University’s Center on Food Security and the Environment (FSE) addresses critical global issues of hunger, poverty and environmental degradation. Our long\-term goals focus on designing new approaches to solving food security’s global challenges by building an evolving research portfolio with a team of experts in relevant scientific, economic, and policy areas. FSE is a joint effort of the Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies and the Stanford Woods Institute for the Environment.  

POSITION SUMMARY:
The Center on Food Security and the Environment (FSE) is seeking a research data analyst (RDA) to contribute to several research projects that combine new data sources and computational tools to study climate impacts on agriculture and food security working with Professor Jen Burney. The RDA will help with identifying, assembling, and geo\-coding datasets on farm and household characteristics, agricultural systems, and environmental outcomes around the world. They will also participate in lab meetings of the Burney and Lobell Groups.  

This recruitment is for a one (1\) year fixed\-term, 100% FTE benefits\-eligible position which begins on the start date and may be renewable in the future based on funding availability.  

For consideration, please submit resume and cover letter. All final candidates must successfully complete a background check.  

PREFERRED/DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
The position will require a very organized and creative person who can write efficient code and work with large datasets, and who is interested in both the physical (natural) and social (human) sides of local, regional, and global food systems. Must have exceptional mathematical and statistical modeling and computer programming skills and willingness to use them in an innovative manner. Must have the ability to work comfortably and effectively within an interdisciplinary research environment. Past data analysts working in this role have earned co\-authorship on top scientific publications and are now enrolled in top PhD programs. Experience with R and Python preferred.
  
**Core Duties** :


* Collect, manage and clean datasets.
* Employ new and existing tools to interpret, analyze, and visualize multivariate relationships in data.
* Create databases and reports, develop algorithms and statistical models, and perform statistical analyses appropriate to data and reporting requirements.
* Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and determine root cause for data problems from input errors or inadequate field edits, and suggest possible solutions.
* Develop reports, charts, graphs and tables for use by investigators and for publication and presentation.
* Analyze data processes in documentation.
* Collaborate with faculty and research staff on data collection and analysis methods.
* Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.
* Communicate with government officials, grant agencies and industry representatives.

**Minimum Education** :


Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and relevant experience.


**Minimum Experience** :


Experience in a quantitative discipline such as economics, finance, statistics or engineering.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Substantial experience with MS Office and analytical programs.
* Strong writing and analytical skills.
* Ability to prioritize workload.

jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist / Geologist
jobs.description:
**Senior Scientist / Geologist**  


Provide Technical Leadership. Drive Innovation. Solve Complex Environmental Challenges.  


**Pay:** Competitive and commensurate with experience  


**Position Type:** Full\-Time, Exempt  


**Location:** Office\-Based with Occasional Field Visits  


**Travel:** Minimal travel required  


**Reports To:** Project Manager  


**The Role**  


The **Senior Scientist / Geologist** serves as a senior technical leader within Tasman's Engineering \& Consulting group, providing expertise, guidance, and strategic direction across large projects, client programs, and cross\-functional teams.  


This role is responsible for defining technical approaches, reviewing complex environmental projects, supporting innovation initiatives, mentoring staff, and helping drive successful project execution. The ideal candidate is a highly experienced environmental professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while supporting the development of project teams and technical programs.  


As a trusted resource across the organization, this position influences project outcomes, technical standards, and long\-term business success.  


**What You'll Be Doing**  


**Technical Leadership \& Environmental Expertise**  


* Provide technical oversight and guidance on complex environmental projects and sites
* Review environmental investigations, remediation strategies, and corrective action approaches
* Evaluate and support implementation of innovative remedial technologies and solutions
* Serve as a technical resource for project teams, clients, and leadership
* Support company\-wide technical initiatives and best practices

**Project Support \& Technical Reviews**  


* Review and provide guidance on work plans, technical reports, and Corrective Action Plans (CAPs)
* Assist project teams with project scoping, planning, scheduling, and technical execution
* Support project managers in managing project risks, deliverables, and client expectations
* Help define project priorities and technical objectives
* Ensure technical consistency, quality, and regulatory compliance across projects

**Leadership, Mentorship \& Collaboration**  


* Mentor and train environmental scientists, geologists, engineers, and project staff
* Lead cross\-functional teams and coordinate technical resources across projects
* Foster accountability, ownership, and collaboration within project teams
* Support workforce development and technical growth initiatives
* Provide high\-level technical problem solving and decision support

**Strategic \& Organizational Support**  


* Contribute to development of technical standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Support innovation efforts and continuous improvement initiatives
* Influence technical direction for major projects and client programs
* Collaborate with engineering, construction, EHS, and project controls teams to achieve project objectives

**What You Bring**  


**Required**  


* Relevant technical diploma, bachelor's degree, or equivalent higher education in Environmental Science, Geology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in environmental consulting, engineering, remediation, or oil \& gas sectors
* Specialized knowledge of environmental investigation and remediation practices
* Demonstrated experience supporting projects of varying size, scope, and complexity
* Experience collaborating with EHS, engineering, construction, and project controls teams
* Advanced technical problem\-solving abilities
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent technical writing and document preparation skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel
* Ability to influence outcomes and drive collaboration across teams
* Valid driver's license
* Authorization to work in the United States

**Preferred**  


* Advanced degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Engineering, or related technical discipline
* Experience working with environmental regulatory agencies
* Strong knowledge of environmental compliance and remediation programs
* Experience leading innovation initiatives and technical development efforts
* Professional registration or certifications relevant to environmental or engineering disciplines

**Work Environment**  


This role operates primarily in a professional office environment with occasional field responsibilities.  


**Office \& Field Conditions**  


* Primarily office\-based work supporting project teams and technical programs
* Occasional field visits for project reviews, evaluations, and technical support
* Exposure to varying weather conditions during site visits
* Potential exposure to environmental contaminants in controlled project settings
* Use of PPE and compliance with all safety requirements during field activities

**Physical Requirements**  


* Frequent computer and office\-based work
* Regular use of hands, fingers, and communication equipment
* Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching
* Ability to walk on uneven terrain during site visits
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 30 pounds

**Schedule**  


* Full\-time
* Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.
* Occasional evening or weekend work based on project demands
* Flexibility to support client and project needs when required

**Required Education \& Experience**  


* Relevant technical diploma or university degree
* 8\+ years of experience in environmental consulting, engineering, remediation, or oil \& gas sectors
* Strong technical expertise in environmental practices and remediation methods
* Experience managing or supporting complex projects and technical programs

**Work Authorization**  


* Must be authorized to work in the United States
* Must possess a valid driver's license

**Benefits**  


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match (up to 4%)
* Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Flexible Spending

jobs.title: GIS Analyst (ArcGIS Pro / GIS Data Maintenance)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Technuf, LLC is a Maryland based SBA certified 8(a) small business company providing leading\-edge and proven technologies, industry vertical domain expertise and highly skilled and motivated professionals to achieve our customers’ mission critical business needs.

**What we’re looking for**

Technuf is seeking a skilled and experienced GIS Data Maintenance and Application Support to work with Montgomery County.

**Job Description:**

The GIS support professional will assist the Montgomery County Police Department GIS program with maintaining GIS data, supporting GIS applications, and performing routine GIS maintenance activities in support of the Department's GIS infrastructure and technology initiatives.

Duties may include:

* Editing, maintaining, and validating GIS datasets.
* Performing quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) on spatial and attribute data.
* Assisting with data cleanup, standardization, and documentation.
* Updating web maps, feature services, and existing GIS applications.
* Assisting with testing GIS applications following software updates or configuration changes.
* Supporting routine GIS maintenance activities and special GIS projects as assigned.
* Assisting with GIS data preparation, map production, and spatial analysis for public safety operations.

Deliverables:

* Accurate and timely updates to GIS datasets.
* Completed QA/QC of assigned GIS data.
* Updated web maps and GIS content.
* Documentation of completed work and procedures.
* Support for GIS application testing and maintenance.

**Requirements:**

* Experience using ArcGIS Pro and other Esri ArcGIS applications.
* GIS data editing and maintenance.
* QA/QC experience.
* Understanding of geodatabases.
* Familiarity with ArcGIS Enterprise or ArcGIS Online.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.

**Education:**

* Degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Relevant Esri coursework or certifications preferred.

**Interviews:**

Please note that both remote and in\-person interviews may be required for this opportunity.

**Location:**

This is a remote position based in Montgomery County.

**Benefits:**

We offer a competitive pay and benefits package that includes generous paid\-time\-off including holidays, short\-and\-long\-term disability; group health insurance including medical, dental and vision coverage, training and 401(k) retirement plan.

*Technuf is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. Members of ethnic minorities, women, special disabled veterans, veterans of the Vietnam\-era, recently separated veterans, and other protected veterans, persons of disability and/or persons age 40 and over are encouraged to apply.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
